summary.text: Bob Heitkamp is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota State Senate, District 25, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Larry Luick.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he built and operated local businesses in construction, retail, hospitality and product development.

paragraphs.text: Heitkamp graduated from Hankinson High School and is listed by Ballotpedia as an executive director.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he studied at North Dakota State College of Science and Valley City State University before building and operating several local businesses.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026, receiving 562 votes.
In the same survey, Heitkamp said he is running to keep small towns strong, protect local schools, maintain roads and improve infrastructure.
He said he supports workforce development, housing growth, child care support, expanded broadband and rural health care, and that he would stand up for family farmers and ranchers.
